description: This file contains Redux Saga generator functions for handling donation-related actions, including showing donation modals, processing charges with various payment providers, handling errors, and updating donation cookies.

methods.name: showDonateModalSaga
methods.description: Saga to control the display of the donation modal, based on user interaction and session storage.

methods.name: postChargeSaga
methods.description: Handles the donation charge process for different payment providers, including error handling and analytics tracking.

methods.name: stripeCardErrorHandler
methods.description: Handles errors related to Stripe card authentication, including user action requirements.

methods.name: setDonationCookieIfDonating
methods.description: Sets a cookie if the user is currently donating.

methods.name: setDonationCookie
methods.description: Sets a cookie indicating the user is a donor.

methods.name: updateCardSaga
methods.description: Handles updating the user's saved card information and redirects to checkout.

methods.name: createDonationSaga
methods.description: Creates saga watchers for donation-related actions.
